policy.stopRule: Do not stop because a numeric target was reached. Stop only after all eligible catalog sources were attempted plus at least two discovery/fallback passes produce no new verified vacancies and no new useful source, or because an external tool/runtime limit is reached.

discoveryRules: Every run search for new Italy/Tuscany job boards, staffing agencies, recruiters, remote boards and ATS domains not already in this catalog.
Discover employers from every promising vacancy, then inspect their official career board in the same run.
Discover ATS host and tenant from each employer apply URL and enumerate the board directly when a public endpoint/feed exists.
Search Tuscan company directories, sector associations, local tech/ICT/healthcare/event/luxury employer lists only as discovery inputs, then verify vacancies on official career pages.
Promote a discovered source into this catalog only after a real accessible job listing/search page or public ATS feed is verified.
Never count a search-engine query itself as complete coverage of the underlying source.
